notes.title: 1.8.0 Update - Endless Mode
notes.notes:
[img]https://dl.dropboxusercontent.com/u/7079101/Rage%20Runner/full%20sized%20cover.jpg[/img]

[h1]Rage Runner 1.8.0 - Endless Mode[/h1]
We are proud to announce the release of version 1.8.0.

[h1]What's New[/h1]
The main highlight of this release is Endless Mode which features procedural level generation, a larger trench and all sorts of other cool stuff![img]https://dl.dropboxusercontent.com/u/7079101/Rage%20Runner/endless.jpg[/img]

[b]COMPETITION[/b]
Compete on the [b]Daily Level[/b] and pass the corpses of other crashed players. Score in the top 3 at the end of the day and you can unlock the [i]fastest[/i] ship in the arsenal!
[img]https://dl.dropboxusercontent.com/u/7079101/Rage%20Runner/tappy.jpg[/img]

[b]JOYRIDE[/b]
Want to kick back and relax with some nice tunes? Try out joyride mode, where everyone's always a winner! This mode is [b]great for children![/b] 3 gold stars guaranteed ;)
[img]https://dl.dropboxusercontent.com/u/7079101/Rage%20Runner/joyride.jpg[/img]

[b]CHANGES[/b]
The old Rage Runner is still here but you'll find it tucked away in [b]PRACTICE[/b] mode. Further changes:
[list]
[*] Added 11 Achievements
[*] Added 5 Leaderboards
[*] Added 4 official levels - These were originally available on Steam Workshop but have been added to the game for higher visibility.
[*] Various bug fixes
[/list]

notes.title: Version 1.7.2 Live
notes.notes:
[h1]Rage Runner[/h1]
[list]
[*][b]FIXED[/b] Multiple connected gamepads are now handled properly. If you previously were disconnecting extra controllers just to play, we apologize :(
[*][b]ADDED[/b] Workaround for Mac font rendering on ATI cards. See discussion thread on [url=http://steamcommunity.com/app/279520/discussions/0/613935404030480802/]Font Workaround[/url].
[/list]

[h1]Arc[/h1]
[list]
[*][b]ADDED[/b] Optional setting to force player 1 to use keyboard/mouse.
[*][b]FIXED[/b] Keyboard/mouse menu navigation shortcuts.
[*][b]FIXED[/b] Generic gamepad button and axis mappings.
[*][b]FIXED[/b] Menu navigation and state issues on entry screen, main menu & armory.
[*][b]FIXED[/b] Test room item browser not triggering for players 2-4.
[*][b]FIXED[/b] UI aspect ratios to prevent items getting cut-off on square-er resolutions.
[*][b]FIXED[/b] No longer allow zero length names.
[*][b]FIXED[/b] Allow bypassing press start screen with any button or click.
[*][b]UPDATED[/b] Respawn points and triggers to prevent z-depth issues after death in Marcio and Test Room.
[/list]

notes.title: Version 1.7.0 Live
notes.notes:
Version 1.7.0 is now live!

[b]New[/b]
[list]
[*]You can now delve deeper into the Arconian backstory by playing Arc, the [i]first [/i]title in the [b]Hyper Arcade Bundle[/b]!
[*]Defeat the evil Blockubus and you'll unlock the nimble Arconian ship in Rage Runner!
[*]We now have a public Roadmap where you can vote on items that you'd like to see next in Rage Runner. Join the community discussion here on Steam to let us know what features you want. Then cast your vote on [url=https://trello.com/b/dQ88aKjw/rage-runner-roadmap]The Rage Runner Roadmap[/url].
[/list]
[b]Fixed[/b]
[list]
[*]Allow exiting the keybinding screen even if all keys are not bound.
[*]Alternate camera views no longer get messed up after explosions.
[/list]

notes.title: Version 1.6.6
notes.notes:
[b]Achievements[/b]
[list]
[*] The achievement for collectibles on Level 7 has been reduced to 55%. We know that the achievement is called "C's Get Degrees" but in this case we'll accept an F+.
[*] # of deaths required for Resilience III has been reduced from 1000 to 250.
[/list]

[b]Changes[/b]
[list]
[*] We decided to remove the level gate. The upside is that if you were stuck on a level, you can finally check out the other cool levels and soundtracks.
[*] Added a retry button on the win screen for those doing highscore runs.
[/list]

[b]Bug Fixes[/b]
[list]
[*] Better gamepad support for non-xbox 360 controllers that use XInput. Please leave feedback if your gamepad has unmappable buttons and we will continue to improve this.
[*] Fix issue that prevented leaderboards from displaying when level was won.
[/list]

notes.title: Version 1.6.0 is Live!
notes.notes:
We lied, we're a few days early!

[h1]New Features[/h1]
The primary feature of this release is the level editor with Steam Workshop integration. You'll find 3 new levels in the workshop that we created to kick things off.

Be sure to check out our new video on the store page for a brief introduction to the level editor along with the [url=http://www.hypercanestudios.com/p/rage-runner-level-editor.html]official level editor docs[/url].

[h1]Leaderboards[/h1]
You can now browse highscore leaderboards in-game. Additionally, all community created levels have their own unique leaderboard!

[h1]Bug Fixes[/h1]
[list]
[*] Properly restore fullscreen/windowed mode setting
[/list]

notes.title: Release Schedule Update
notes.notes:
Hey folks. We wanted to get our first major update on the radar.

[h1]Release 1.6.0 is scheduled for June 20th[/h1]

[b]New Features[/b]
[list]
[*] Level Editor with Steam Workshop support
[*] New Levels
[*] Easier leaderboard access
[*] Major bug fixes
[/list]

The level editor and steam workshop integration is a huge effort on our part. So although this feature list may look slim, it is sized based on a reasonable estimate of how much we can get done.

Thanks to those that are submitting bugs, please continue to submit them so we can track and prioritize them. Towards the end of the first week of June, we may be asking willing people to opt-in to our beta to help test the editor.

notes.title: 1.5.3 Live - Small Bugfixes & Workshop Prep
notes.notes:
We have just pushed out a minor update that fixes some reported bugs. It also takes us a step closer to having workshop support. 

A huge thanks to all that have been posting enhancement requests, problem reports and recommendations. We hear your requests and they are officially on our todo list.

[b]Bugfixes[/b]
[list]
[*] Fix an issue that caused controller type to continually get reset to gamepad if a gamepad was plugged in.
[*] Some settings screen items were not refreshing with localized text when the language was changed.
[/list]

[b]Other Changes[/b]
[list]
[*] Broke game assets up into smaller self-contained modules in preparation for Steam workshop support.
[*] Culled 2 MB worth of unused game assets.
[/list]
